alt: Manage Permissions for the Admin role: modules grouped by area, each with a name and a short description, View, Create, Update, Delete and Full access columns, Allow All and Save Permissions
_source: Local EF app (EF_APP=http://127.0.0.1:8010), demo organization 798, its real Admin role. The capture reloads the list, opens Admin's menu, Manage Permissions, and scrolls the grid to the Funnels group. Re-shoot: EF_APP=<local app> node tools/shots/shoot.cjs organization-role-permissions

actions.eval: (() => { const sc = document.querySelector('.ant-modal-content .simplebar-content-wrapper'); const h = [...sc.querySelectorAll('h3.col-label')].find(t => t.textContent.trim() === 'Funnels'); sc.scrollTop += h.getBoundingClientRect().top - sc.getBoundingClientRect().top - 56; })()

annotations.title: Save Permissions
annotations.text: Applies to everyone with this role
